purpose: Separate sign-consistent scale transfer from a statistical claim that the final Speck architecture has a better loss-compute frontier.

evidence_basis.supported: multiple active-parameter points under fixed FLOP budgets are stronger evidence than one large model
evidence_basis.not_transferred: Kimi's fitted frontier, hyperparameters, 3B-active result, or optimal ratio

evidence_basis.supported: architecture loss gaps and trailing-token behavior can change with scale
evidence_basis.not_transferred: MoBA's fitted gap or compute-optimal allocation

evidence_basis.supported: efficient-attention rankings can reverse on harder capabilities and larger scales
evidence_basis.not_transferred: MiniMax's data, post-training, or reversal as a prediction for Speck

evidence_basis.supported: a scaling claim needs at least five points, uncertainty, residuals, and a held-out point
evidence_basis.not_transferred: a claim from proxy, medium, or target sentinel evidence alone

claim_separation.scale_transfer: the selected candidate's paired primary effect retains direction and required gates at a larger named scale
claim_separation.scaling_efficiency: the candidate's fitted loss frontier versus analytic compute and realized time/energy is better across a predeclared range
claim_separation.rule: three-scale sign consistency is necessary for the architecture thesis but does not by itself establish a scaling-law advantage

entry_gate: the final candidate and strongest conventional baseline are frozen with immutable config generators
sequence, depth, width, interaction, and final-removal gates are complete
one deterministic depth/width/head/expert scaling rule exists for each architecture
tokenizer, data family, validation, optimizer-tuning budget, and analytic cost accounting are frozen
named hardware, parallelism, storage, energy measurement, and total resource ceiling cover every fit and held-out run
candidate/control contamination windows and result-access rules are frozen

scale_points.held_out_role: one matched reversal and prediction sentinel; no population-equivalence authority
scale_points.geometry_tolerance: materialized active parameters must be within 2% of each nominal target and candidate/control within 0.25% inside a scale cell
scale_points.rule: report nominal, materialized active, total, embedding, expert, cache/state, and residual-summary parameters separately

compute_optimal_allocation.pilot_design: run the same 3x3 N-by-D/N allocation grid for candidate and control with an identical hyperparameter search budget
compute_optimal_allocation.cost: use architecture-specific analytic forward-plus-backward training FLOPs including embeddings, attention/recurrent/sparse/expert/residual operations; report realized time and energy separately
compute_optimal_allocation.selection: for each fit-scale compute budget, minimize the preregistered joint-fit prediction over batch-aligned D subject to D/N in [10,40]
compute_optimal_allocation.rounding: round D down to a complete frozen global token batch and report the prediction change
compute_optimal_allocation.separation: allocation pilots select token budgets only; their losses are not reused as the five confirmatory frontier points

tuned_per_architecture_scale: global batch within the hardware envelope
optimization_fairness.budget: the same number of tuning trials, seeds, token fraction, and selection metric for both architectures at every scale
optimization_fairness.selection: choose hyperparameters on a disjoint tuning window before confirmatory seed/data cells
optimization_fairness.forbidden: reuse a winning candidate setting for an untuned control or spend more trials on one architecture

confirmatory_fit.fit_separately: candidate and control have separate coefficients under the same functional form and fitting algorithm
confirmatory_fit.optimization: bounded nonlinear least squares with parameter transforms, a frozen deterministic multi-start grid, and every converged/local solution retained
confirmatory_fit.weights: inverse paired-variance weights estimated from the three confirmatory seed/data cells with a preregistered variance floor
reported: observed and fitted loss per scale
candidate-minus-control fitted difference over the declared compute range
sensitivity to unweighted fit and each retained local optimum

uncertainty.method: paired hierarchical bootstrap that resamples seed/data cells within scale and refits allocation plus both frontier models
uncertainty.failure_rule: failed optimization or boundary solutions remain in the bootstrap failure count; do not silently discard until intervals tighten
uncertainty.multiplicity: the global frontier claim is primary; scale-specific contrasts and diagnostics are secondary with Holm correction when used as confirmatory claims

freeze_before_run: candidate and control expected loss intervals
held_out_prediction.pass: both observed losses fall inside their 95% predictive intervals, the paired advantage has the predicted sign, and the absolute standardized residual for each architecture is at most 2
held_out_prediction.failure: the scaling-efficiency claim fails or is narrowed; the sentinel cannot be used to refit and then declared held out

training_horizon_interaction.model: paired loss difference as a function of log training tokens with architecture-by-horizon interaction and retained per-source traces
training_horizon_interaction.rule: a proxy advantage that disappears or reverses by ten or twenty tokens per active parameter blocks extrapolation
training_horizon_interaction.current_baseline_limit: 131072000 tokens over approximately 154M parameters is below one token per parameter and is only a proxy screen

required_at_every_fit_scale: mechanism diagnostics appropriate to retained components
structured retrieval and symbolic composition at feasible lengths
required_at_medium_and_held_out: post-training evaluation only under its own matched frozen recipe
quality_and_capability.rule: a loss-compute fit cannot override a capability reversal or missing required suite

decision_contract.scale_transfer_pass: primary paired effect keeps its predicted sign and every quality/systems gate passes at proxy-finalist and medium scales
decision_contract.scaling_efficiency_pass: the lower 95% simultaneous bootstrap bound on candidate advantage is positive over the declared compute range and the held-out sentinel passes
decision_contract.inconclusive: overlapping frontier uncertainty, unstable optimization, or crossing within the claim range yields no scaling-efficiency claim
decision_contract.failure: held-out miss, sign reversal, capability failure, or worse realized time/energy prevents the broad efficiency claim
decision_contract.no_extrapolation: claims stop at the largest passing held-out scale/context/hardware regime

decision.next_action: after architecture selection, freeze deterministic geometry generators and price the complete pilot/fit/sentinel resource envelope before any scaling run
